subject: website
name: IPLD Explorer
summary: The IPLD Explorer for walking a CID's Merkle DAG, source public in ipld/explore.ipld.io (MIT). It runs no third-party code and makes no request when it opens. Level 4: blocks are fetched by CID from trustless gateways and checked by hash, and delegated routing only finds providers. Not privacy: exploring a CID shows the user's IP address and the CID to those gateways, routers and, for DNSLink names, DNS resolvers.

connections.name: Trustless gateways, routing (trustless-gateway.link, delegated-ipfs.dev)
connections.note: Used only when a CID is explored; blocks are checked by hash.

connections.name: DNS over HTTPS (cloudflare-dns.com, dns.google)
connections.note: Used only to resolve a DNS name the user enters.
